producer_progress_snapshot.note: Preserved without modification. Producer progress may lag sealed case files; terminal inventory uses actual case files.

resume_contract: No interruption is converted into a native model error or scored case. Future explicit resumption must verify all frozen identity/protocol/config bindings, retain original terminal cases/errors, replay saved completions in a fresh native environment, match saved original-request boundaries, and continue only pending native work. No resume command or execution is created by this inventory. GPU-drained completion records may be saved under calls/ after bridge shutdown; root must inventory these separately without assuming bridge receipt exists.

not_verified: Model checkpoint parameters or model runtime numeric equivalence
Nested bridge receipt artifacts under calls/ including NPZ input/output/full-head state data; these are intentionally left to root final GPU-drain inventory
Full778 native replay, final audit, ASR or hidden-state/probe mathematics
Whole calls directory stability while GPU server drains already accepted requests
verified: All currently sealed cases are unique members of immutable original778 schedule, exact schedule fields and spec hash
Complete cases have boolean native utility/security; original error cases retain null utility/security
Case raw_trace and resumed_partial_trace references match SHA256; raw scored values match case scores
All referenced bridge receipts plus original request/response byte SHAs, canonical request binding, server identity and call ordering
All currently partial raw traces are mapped to scheduled case IDs; saved request semantic message prefixes and final pending boundary match
Case directory path/byte SHA snapshot identical before and after; all inventoried files reread and unchanged
